integrity: The infinite-size law follows from a written coupling proof; standalone finite tests verify the exact event and mean. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform student preferences and independent uniform school-specific priorities are required.
The matching is exogenously fixed; conclusions do not extend to endogenous deferred-acceptance or other mechanism outcomes.
The window is n-h for fixed integer h>=2; no growing-h conclusion is made.
The most directly related manuscript was accessible only at abstract level; uncatalogued equivalent computations remain possible.
title: Extreme-priority envy in random school assignments: a compound-Poisson cluster law
